extracted.subtask_description: An encyclopedic Wikipedia article about American poet Patricia Smith that summarizes her life, career, works, awards, and controversies; includes editorial/template notices aimed at Wikipedia editors (e.g., sourcing and completeness notices).

rubrics_metrics.name: Biographies of living persons — sourcing and removal of unsourced contentious material
rubrics_metrics.description: This biography of a living person needs additional citations for verification. Please help by adding reliable sources. Contentious material about living persons that is unsourced or poorly sourced must be removed immediately from the article and its talk page, especially if potentially libelous.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Find sources: "Patricia Smith" poet – news · newspapers · books · scholar · JSTOR (July 2022) (Learn how and when to remove this message). Emphasizes adding reliable sources for verification and the immediate removal of unsourced or poorly sourced contentious material, particularly when potentially libelous.

rubrics_metrics.name: Incomplete lists — invitation to expand bibliography/works
rubrics_metrics.description: This list is incomplete; you can help by adding missing items.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: A maintenance/editorial note indicating the bibliography/works sections are not exhaustive and inviting contributors to add verified missing entries. No specific scoring guidance beyond encouraging expansion with reliable sourcing.
